stories.title: El refugio de Marc Cucurella: una vivienda unifamiliar en un municipio de 60.000 habitantes

en.title: Marc Cucurella's refuge: a single-family home in a municipality of 60,000 inhabitants
en.summary: Marc Cucurella, a world champion Spanish defender, has made a positive impression on José Mourinho at Real Madrid during his early weeks with the club.

stories.title: Un mercante iraní es atacado cerca del Estrecho de Ormuz, según medios estatales iraníes

en.title: An Iranian merchant ship is attacked near the Strait of Hormuz, according to Iranian state media
en.summary: Iranian state media reported an attack on an Iranian merchant vessel near the Strait of Hormuz, as regional foreign ministers prepare to meet on efforts by Iran and Oman toward an agreement.

stories.title: Perfumería y mascotas, sus dos nuevos negocios para dominar a la competencia

en.title: Perfumery and pets, its two new businesses to dominate the competition
en.summary: Mercadona, a dominant Spanish supermarket chain, leads market share across multiple retail segments including pet products and perfumery, outperforming specialized competitors.

stories.title: Las noventa tumbas sin nombre de Ceuta

en.title: The ninety nameless graves of Ceuta
en.summary: Ninety unidentified individuals have been buried in unmarked common graves at a Muslim cemetery in Ceuta following the deaths from a migration incident at Tarajal beach.

stories.title: 12 años para investigar si altos cargos socialistas de la Junta se coordinaron para repartir 900 millones de euros sin control en los cursos de formación para parados

en.title: 12 years to investigate whether high-ranking socialist officials from the Regional Government coordinated to distribute 900 million euros without oversight in unemployment training courses
en.summary: A judge has reopened a case regarding allegations that socialist officials may have coordinated the uncontrolled distribution of 900 million euros in unemployment training programs, following a directive from Seville's provincial court.

stories.title: Alumnos de casa Árabe piden una reunión a Almeida para no desalojar el edificio

en.title: Casa Árabe students request a meeting with Almeida to prevent building eviction
en.summary: Students at Casa Árabe are seeking a meeting with Madrid's mayor regarding an eviction order set for September 1st for the building they occupy.

stories.title: Sam Altman descarta la salida a Bolsa de OpenAI en 2026: "Dada la situación actual en materia de seguridad, no sería el momento adecuado"

en.title: Sam Altman rules out OpenAI's stock market debut in 2026: "Given the current situation regarding safety, it would not be the right moment"
en.summary: OpenAI's chief executive has stated the company will not pursue an initial public offering in 2026, citing current safety considerations as a limiting factor.

stories.title: Abdellatif Hammouchi, el hombre que pudo evitar el asalto a Ceuta

en.title: Abdellatif Hammouchi, the man who could have prevented the assault on Ceuta
en.summary: Morocco's interior intelligence director and police chief, a close associate of King Mohamed VI, received advance warning from Spanish intelligence about an incident at Ceuta and could have reinforced the border.

stories.title: La Policía traslada a más de 800 migrantes a una nueva instalación: “¿Nos llevan a Marruecos?"

en.title: Police transfer over 800 migrants to new facility: "Are they taking us to Morocco?"
en.summary: Police moved over 800 migrants on foot to a new facility in the La Reina neighborhood. The group included young people who had been sleeping rough for more than a month.

stories.title: Más de 5.100 objetos perdidos en Madrid durante agosto: joyas, carteras y gafas a la cabeza

en.title: Over 5,100 lost items in Madrid during August: jewelry, wallets and glasses leading
en.summary: Madrid's lost and found office received over 5,100 items during August, with jewelry, wallets and glasses among the most common lost articles.

stories.title: El fervor por Céline Dion invade París ante su retorno a los escenarios

en.title: Fervor for Céline Dion invades Paris ahead of her return to the stage
en.summary: Céline Dion is returning to perform concerts in Paris this Saturday after pausing her music career in 2020 due to a neurological condition. The Canadian singer's comeback has generated significant anticipation in France, with 26 concerts planned at the Plenitude Arena in La Défense.

stories.title: Céline Dion en su retorno a la escena: "Había prometido no llorar, no cumplo mis promesas"

en.title: Céline Dion on her return to the stage: "I promised not to cry, I'm breaking my promises"
en.summary: Céline Dion made her stage comeback after dealing with Stiff Person Syndrome, a rare neurological condition, opening her performance with the song "On ne change pas".

stories.title: Isabel Rodríguez: Casa 47 habrá puesto 100.000 pisos en alquiler en 10 años

en.title: Isabel Rodríguez: Casa 47 will have placed 100,000 rental apartments in 10 years
en.summary: The Government expects Casa 47, the public housing platform, to offer 100,000 rental apartments over a 10-year period, according to housing minister Isabel Rodríguez.

stories.title: Altman: "Sería poco aconsejable" sacar OpenAI a Bolsa ante los riesgos de la IA

en.title: Altman: "It would be inadvisable" to take OpenAI public amid AI risks
en.summary: OpenAI's CEO Sam Altman ruled out a near-term stock market debut, stating 2026 would be an inopportune time to go public given the need to resolve safety challenges in advanced AI models.

stories.title: No busque la habilidad mejor pagada; pregunte qué problema resuelve y cómo combinarla

en.title: Don't seek the best-paid skill; ask what problem it solves and how to combine it
en.summary: Companies increasingly reward professionals who blend technical expertise with business acumen and leadership to address complex organizational challenges, rather than those skilled in single domains.

stories.title: IA: ¿Y si muchos empleos no desaparecen pero dejan de crearse?

en.title: AI: What if many jobs don't disappear but simply stop being created?
en.summary: Labor market discussions are shifting from concerns about job elimination to consideration of whether automation may prevent new positions from being created in the first place.

stories.title: Automatizar lo básico obligará a pedir habilidades sénior a los novatos

en.title: Automating basics will force companies to demand senior-level skills from newcomers
en.summary: Companies now prioritize analytical thinking, resilience, and communication skills over basic job competencies, seeking agile professionals willing to learn as AI accelerates workplace transformation.
